@@ -85,17 +85,13 @@ Every note must contain:
 - one atomic body with a non-empty opening summary paragraph
 - one links section with explicit connections
 
-Target values:
-
-- `current`: implemented in code, tested, and trusted
-- `v0.4`: planned for that release and not yet implemented
-- `v0.5`: planned for that release and not yet implemented
-- `v0.6`: planned for that release and not yet implemented
-- `backlog`: future idea that is not scheduled
+Target values are project-defined routing labels. `current` is the default
+label generated by `cx notes new`; teams can add their own labels and can
+constrain them with `[notes.frontmatter.fields.target]` in `cx.toml`.
 
 ## Governance And CI
 
-- `validateNotes(...)` enforces the summary requirement, minimum summary substance, template replacement, note size limits, and required frontmatter target.
+- `validateNotes(...)` enforces timestamp note ids, the summary requirement, minimum summary substance, template replacement, note size limits, and required frontmatter target.
 - `cx notes check` surfaces governance failures, broken links, and graph drift.
 - `cx notes check` also warns when a `target: current` note references missing note or code targets, so implemented truth does not silently drift into ambiguity.
 - `bun run ci:notes:governance` keeps the cognition-layer gate visible as its own CI lane.
